incidents.message:
• 2014-12-26 05:57:08 - We're investigating intermittent issues with one of our upstream transit providers
  • 2014-12-26 06:00:05 - Everything operating normally.

incidents.name: Incident on 2014-12-25 07:10:35 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2014-12-25 07:10:35 - We're receiving reports of intermittent connectivity issues for some of our users and are currently investigating.
  • 2014-12-25 07:41:15 - The intermittent connectivity problems were the result of problems with one of our upstream network providers. The issues have been resolved however we're keeping a close eye on the situation to make sure.

incidents.name: Incident on 2014-12-23 23:06:50 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2014-12-23 23:06:50 - Minor service outage.
  • 2014-12-23 23:11:39 - We're enabling DDoS mitigation after detecting a large incoming spike in traffic volume.
  • 2014-12-23 23:34:58 - Our metrics show nominal TCP performance statistics in spite of the DDoS. We'll continue to monitor and mitigate as necessary.

  • 2014-12-11 04:50:19 - Everything operating normally.
